reply: A parrot took my ring. Look for its perch and bring a rake.
Thank you for my ring. I have an errand for you.
Deliver this payment to Charlotta and tell me when it is done.
The payment is settled. You may report back to Eleonore.
Thank you. You have my trust. Ask me about the peg leg.
Say peg leg to Captain Waverider. He can take you to Meriana.
Bring thirty pieces of wood for repairs.
The ship is ready. You have passage to Goroma.
Speak to Marina about me.
Find someone who can persuade me to let Raymond go.
Ask Marina whether she would meet me.
I will consider it if he sends me a poem.
Elvith can sell you the love poem I need.
Here is the love poem.
Thank you for the poem. Tell Marina the date is arranged.
I will meet Ocelus. You may ride my sea turtles.
Take Sebastian’s boat to Nargor and use a fire bug on the catapult lever.
The catapult is out of action.
Read all three plans in the Nargor tavern.
Find out what proof Klaus wants of my death.
Bring me Raymond’s lucky pillow as proof.
Take my lucky pillow to Klaus.
You brought the pillow. I believe you.
You have earned passage to Meriana, the Laguna Islands, Goroma and Nargor.
